name: issue489-matched-mcp-http-v1

topology.upstreamProcess: owned child with IPC readiness and OS-assigned loopback port
topology.reason: Parallel workloads require modern HTTP upstream; the legacy upstream connection intentionally admits one operation

rotation: rotate modes by repetition to reduce thermal and order bias
collectorOutage: HTTP 503 from a loopback Collector; separately exercise slow responses and queue saturation
noisePolicy: at least three paired repetitions; extend until 95 percent paired confidence intervals resolve each budget; unresolved intervals are inconclusive
settleReason: All four modes settle equally after the same warmup to match process age, background JIT and timer activity before measurement

memory.method: Fresh baseline and healthy processes; identical 16-request batches every 100ms, exact counts and operation mix; alternate pair order. Reject any batch that overruns its slot. Compare peak RSS in paired 95% intervals; no forced GC or baseline-growth subtraction.
memory.baseline: Same-build test-only propagation-disabled baseline; includes propagation plus recording/export overhead at default 10% sampling.
memory.budget: healthy.rssMiB remains 64; saturated timing and max-queue outage stress are separate gates.
